About me

I am a second-year M.E. student studying electronic and information engineering in the School of Information Science and Technology at Fudan University (FDU) where I am advised by Prof. Zhuo Zou and Prof. Li-Rong Zheng. I am also with the State Key Laboratory of ASIC and System, Fudan University. Before that, I received my B.E. degree in microelectronics science and engineering from the School of Electronics and Information Technology (School of Microelectronis) at Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU).

I have a broad interest in Content Addressable Memory (CAM)-based architecture, low-power VLSI design and the memory-centric neuromorphic hardware.
